review_basis: Frozen report prose, extracted elements, formal-plan attempts and generated P/I/V. DeepSeek output and Z3 results were not treated as semantic ground truth.

ratings.reason: The report clearly states the modified fee mechanism, comparison setup, intended constant-product/fee behavior and excess LP loss. The model produced plausible comparison or conservation plans, but all attempts failed deterministic observable grounding, so no final candidate exists.

The duration-blind reward scenario and duration-proportional safety intent are explicit. Proportional fairness is a plausible class, but the generated templates did not satisfy the class-pattern compatibility rules, so no final formula was emitted.

The report is suitable, but extraction omitted a precondition representing spot deviation exceeding tolerance. The first formal attempt then used that ungrounded condition and was correctly rejected; later retries changed relation shape without producing a valid grounded plan.

State correspondence is correct, but P includes the erroneous reported_decimals == 6 result. More importantly, expected_decimals is never constrained to usdm_decimals + decimals_offset, so I and V cannot express the report's concrete 12-versus-6 mismatch. V is only the structural negation of this under-specified I.

The report and elements clearly describe the lot-size, fill and dust condition. The initial progress/liveness plan captures that sub-lot dust must not cause a revert, but the last retry returned extra JSON data and the run ended without a final candidate.

summary.interpretation: Small assistant artifact review. It measures this frozen batch only and is not expert gold, population accuracy or proof of semantic correctness.
